title: Saga sequence
description: Slack → Sheets → Calendar → Gmail draft, then asserts.
mermaid:
%%{init: {"theme":"dark","themeVariables":{"actorBkg":"#1B3A28","actorBorder":"#7CFFB2","actorTextColor":"#F4F7FA","actorLineColor":"#7CFFB2","signalColor":"#7CFFB2","signalTextColor":"#F4F7FA","labelBoxBkgColor":"#14301F","labelBoxBorderColor":"#7CFFB2","labelTextColor":"#F4F7FA","noteBkgColor":"#0F241A","noteTextColor":"#B7C3D1","noteBorderColor":"#9AA7B8","activationBkgColor":"#14301F","activationBorderColor":"#7CFFB2","sequenceNumberColor":"#07140F","fontFamily":"ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif","fontSize":"15px"}} }%%
sequenceDiagram
  autonumber
  participant Trig as Trigger
  participant Pol as PolicyEngine
  participant Slack as Slack
  participant Sheets as Sheets
  participant Cal as Calendar
  participant Gmail as Gmail
  participant Eval as Asserts

  Trig->>Pol: evidence pack + ARR-at-risk
  alt deny / kill switch
    Pol-->>Trig: UNLATCHED (no side-effects)
  else allow
    Pol->>Slack: #cs alert
    Slack-->>Pol: message_ts
    Pol->>Sheets: OPEN_SAVE row
    Sheets-->>Pol: updatedRange
    Pol->>Cal: save-call hold
    Cal-->>Pol: eventId
    Pol->>Gmail: create draft (no send)
    Gmail-->>Pol: draftId
    Pol->>Eval: prove every ID
    alt all IDs present
      Eval-->>Pol: LATCHED
    else missing ID
      Eval-->>Pol: UNLATCHED + compensate
    end
  end
